S7 WHAT THIS CANNOT SHOW
Four compounds with four mechanisms -- a nuclear receptor agonist, an HDAC
inhibitor, an MDM2 antagonist and an IKK inhibitor. Nothing general about drugs
follows from four of them.
Nutlin at 100 uM has 86 cells and BMS 129. The extrapolation gate S4 lands exactly
on the thinnest pseudobulk in the dataset.
One cell line, one timepoint: nothing here separates a dose response from a time
response.
A Hill curve on seven points cannot tell cooperativity from curvature caused by
cell death, and three of these compounds are cytotoxic at the top dose.
